## About

Ayush Bisen (Ayush Satyawan Bisen) is studying for a B.Tech in Computer Science and Business Systems at St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering & Technology, Nagpur (2024–2028). From workflow automation and campus systems to AI-powered tools, Ayush likes understanding how things work, building them from scratch, and shipping something people can actually use.

Skills: C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL; React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS; Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs, JWT, OAuth; MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis; Git, Docker; Redux, Zustand; Firebase, Cloudinary, Zerops, Cloudflare R2.

## Selected projects

- CampusX (AssetFlow Campus): a production asset-management system for a real college, with QR asset tracking, conflict-checked bookings, a maintenance kanban and automated NAAC/NBA accreditation reports.
- AssetFlow: a multi-tenant enterprise asset and resource management platform with lifecycle tracking, transfers, booking conflict detection and role-based access.
- KizunaX: an AI digital identity platform that turns students' certificates, resumes and projects into a searchable portfolio, using OCR, LLMs, a knowledge graph and ChromaDB.
- SachCheck: an AI deepfake and scam detection platform for video, image and audio, with explainable verdicts.

All projects: https://ayshrosine.tech/work
